Luxclusif is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of Farfetch since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusif has pioneered the global luxury resale market, with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, ensuring item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers.

THE TEAM

Our R&D team is responsible for designing, developing, and evolving the internal products that power our business. As a B2B company specialising in second-hand luxury items, we rely on technology to optimise every stage of our operations, from buying and inbound logistics to selling and post-sales support. We are a global team with members across Portugal, Brazil, and the Philippines.

PORTO

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

THE ROLE

As a Data Scientist you will be part of a multidisciplinary team within the Data cluster, responsible for the development of strategic data products to enable company competitiveness and analytical insights collaborating closer with the R&D Products line. We're looking for a team player that is passionate about tech products and is looking for eager opportunities to grow.

What You’ll Do


Collaboratively design, build, and maintain solutions within our platform using multiple tools applying statistical approaches and machine learning techniques
Working closely with our Engineers and Analysts in highly impactful and complex challenges. Design, Build and Expand our data products, taking them to the next level while using state-of-the-art technologies
Perform analysis and experiments that allow the team to identify opportunities and follow new implementations contributing directly to the evolution of our data products





Who You Are


You have a degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Machine Learning or equivalent specialized training/certification
You have at least 5 years of experience in the role or similar with proven experience on data science environments, building and architecture production-level data products
You’re capable to design, model, develop, test and maintain machine learning solutions and you have the experience to productize these solutions
You have experience in SQL and Python programming (familiar with TensorFlow and other machine learning libraries)
You’ve a strong sense of the data lifecycle and you’re obsessed with data quality
Proactive mindset regarding AI tools and solutions with high impact for the business and productivity
You are problem solving oriented and you’re also comfortable speaking English
Experience with CI/CD tools and cloud environments





Rewards & Benefits


Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools
Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community
Training opportunities and free access to Udemy
Flexible benefits program

As specialists in technology solutions for retail, we provide solutions strategy, implementation, deployment, training and support services for clients across a range of retail segments including fashion, grocery, pharmacy, do it yourself, telecommunications, and electronics.   • The opportunity to work with best-in-breed methodologies, tools and techniques;
  • Training and Mentoring/Talent Development programs;

  • Extra days off;

Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Contribute to the performance of the Natixis Credit Risk Department as a Data Quality Scientist – AI & Innovation within the Credit Risk Monitoring (CRM) team. You will work within an international team (Paris/Charenton and Porto) whose objectives are:


Data Governance & Quality: Control and optimize the credit risk data lifecycle (governance, controls, remediation).
Regulatory & Internal Compliance: Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
Automation & Innovation: Develop and implement solutions for better data exploitation and enhanced risk processes.
Committee Coordination: Lead and facilitate credit risk monitoring bodies.


You will play a key role in mastering credit risk and respecting reference frameworks. Your missions will be to:


Utilize AI techniques to develop innovative solutions for optimizing business processes, enhancing customer experiences, and driving strategic decision-making.
Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to extract actionable insights from large and complex datasets.
Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering and model evaluation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of predictive models.
Collaborate with multiple teams to identify and prioritize business problems that can be addressed through data analysis and predictive modeling.
Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions that deliver tangible value.
Stay aware of the latest developments in AI, ML and data science, and identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies and techniques to drive continuous improvement. 


Who are you? If you recognize yourself in the following description, you are made to work with us:


You have more than three years of experience in a similar role, ideally within a bank or a financial institution.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning and will play a critical role in developing and implementing advanced analytics solutions to support our business objectives. 


Qualifications


Advanced degree in computer science, data science, machine learning, statistics or a related field.
Proven experience in developing and deploying machine learning models in a business environment and with deep learning (genAI).
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and SQL, as well as experience with data manipulation and visualization libraries.
Strong understanding of statistical methods, data mining techniques, and predictive modeling approaches.
Familiarity with deep learning frameworks and experience in developing and deploying AI applications.
Strong desire to learn and eager to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and innovative environment.
The ability to train, facilitate, and effectively share complex concepts with various Natixis teams. Excellent oral and written communication skills.
You have excellent interpersonal skills, great listening abilities, and you are:
Rigorous and proactive
Endowed with strong analytical and synthesis skills
Adaptable in order to achieve your goals
You are fluent in English with a B2 level.

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. Title: Data Scientist (Risk)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who'll effectively assess and manage risk by developing policies, methodologies, models, and systems for risk quantification, reporting, and monitoring.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing


Developing and maintaining methodologies and policies for liquidity and market derivative modelling
Delivering real impact to the product through rigorous data-driven solutions
Building, enhancing, and maintaining the core risk engine, including margin models, leverage frameworks, and liquidation logic
Developing and calibrating risk models across isolated/cross margin, partial/full liquidation, bankruptcy pricing, and future portfolio margining capabilities
Collaborating with Engineering to deploy risk methodologies into production systems while iteratively improving models based on market conditions
Automating advanced analytic workflows, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, short-term investment performance, and cash flow analysis
Preparing documentation for compliance, and presenting risk insights, exposures, and recommendations to senior leadership


What You'll Need


A degree in mathematics, statistics, financial engineering, machine learning, or computer science
3+ years of experience in machine learning, financial engineering, or similar roles within liquidity or market derivatives
Knowledge of margin trading mechanics, derivatives pricing models, and liquidation/liquidity risk management
Expertise in building and validating risk and margin models (VaR, Expected Shortfall, SPAN, CCP-style IM/VM, stress tests, scenario simulations)
Proficiency in quantitative modelling and time-series methods (GARCH, ARIMA, stochastic calculus), with advanced Python and SQL skills for large-scale data analysis
Familiarity with high-frequency datasets, and the ability to work well in fast-paced risk environments


Nice to have


Experience at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider, or within a treasury or risk department (FTP, ALM, liquidity, IRRB, etc.)
Exposure to market-making workflows and risks (inventory management, P&L drivers, spread optimisation, and internalisation strategies)
Familiarity with regulatory and institutional risk frameworks (Basel III/IV, FRTB, SA-CCR, CCP margin methodologies)


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Shiny & Pharma Specialist
Description:
The Shiny lead who turns pharma analytics into actionable apps.




About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics. This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you. Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.




About the role

You will lead the design and delivery of Shiny-based analytics applications for pharma clients, acting as the technical lead on projects and coordinating across developers, data engineers and client stakeholders. You will apply SAGE methodology to structure analytics work, provide senior-level technical support for complex application issues when needed, and ensure outputs map to client needs and commercial value.




Skills and experience




Core Technical Skills

Design, build and optimise Shiny applications that integrate with APIs and demonstrate end-to-end app performance considerations, including data modelling such as star schema.
Produce high-quality, documented SQL and R code with unit tests and reproducible setup, including developing, testing and maintaining reusable R packages for production use, and use containerisation and environment tools such as Docker and Windows Subsystem for Linux to package and distribute solutions.




Interpersonal Traits

Lead customer-facing technical discussions, present project progress and trade-offs to stakeholders, and explain technical risks clearly to non-technical audiences.
Builds strong user relationships by listening carefully to feedback, clarifying needs and communicating progress and outcomes clearly.
Mentor and review colleagues’ work by providing clear, actionable technical feedback and supporting onboarding to develop team capability.
Engage in agile ceremonies and contribute to architectural discussions, driving adoption of good practices and pragmatic technical decisions across the team.




Pharma Experience

Operate in the tech lead role on pharma engagements, coordinating delivery and making decisions that reflect pharma project constraints.
Apply SAGE methodology to structure analytics workstreams and ensure outputs align with client expectations in pharma projects.




Nice to Have

Core Data Science Skills such as; applying statistical rigour and machine learning methods, including designing A/B testing frameworks using frequentist and Bayesian approaches.
Experience using established Shiny development frameworks, such as golem or Rhino, to build structured, maintainable and production-ready applications.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with the ability to use these technologies to create and enhance interactive visualisations and improve the user experience of Shiny applications.
Experience using the data.table R package to efficiently manipulate, transform and analyse large or complex datasets.




What you will do

Lead delivery of Shiny-based analytics projects for pharma accounts, coordinating cross-functional teams to meet defined success criteria and timelines.
Support user testing by gathering customer feedback on applications, translating it into clear technical requirements, implementing fixes and communicating outcomes back to users.
Advise clients on technical solution design and identify capability or capacity gaps that shape the account approach and opportunity discovery.
Plan and estimate technical delivery work, supporting project management with realistic technical scope, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
Own key deliverables end-to-end, including defining success metrics, performing quality control and presenting outputs that link analytics work to commercial impact.
Contribute to internal assets, proofs-of-concept and accelerators to scale our Shiny and analytics offerings across accounts.
Drive reductions in technical debt by proposing pragmatic trade-offs, prioritising fixes that restore service, and defining repayment plans to improve long-term stability.




Why join us

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.

Job Description



As a Data Scientist, you will help shape the future of manufacturing by transforming complex engineering and production challenges into data-driven solutions that create measurable business value.



Working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Industrial Analytics, you will analyse manufacturing data to uncover patterns, identify root causes and drive process improvements. Your insights will support smarter decisions, enhance product quality and increase operational efficiency across manufacturing environments.



You will develop and validate AI/ML models and advanced analytics solutions for use cases such as:



Quality improvement and process optimization
Anomaly detection and root cause analysis
Predictive maintenance and failure prediction
Productivity and yield improvement
Process stability monitoring
Decision support for engineering and manufacturing teams

As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate closely with Process Experts, Technology Development Engineers, Data Analysts, MES/PLC specialists, Data Engineers, MLOps teams, IT professionals and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, explainable and aligned with real operational needs.



You will contribute throughout the entire solution lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration to model development, validation, deployment support and continuous improvement. In addition, you will help standardize and reuse analytical methods, models and best practices across projects and locations, supporting Bosch's digital transformation journey and Industry 4.0 initiatives.





Qualifications



What distinguishes you:



Education



MSc or PhD in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics or a related field.
Academic or professional background in machine learning, statistics, optimization or data-driven problem solving.

Experience



Experience developing Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or Advanced Analytics solutions.
Hands-on experience working with complex datasets in industrial, engineering, manufacturing or technical environments.
Experience contributing to end-to-end data science projects, including data preparation, model development, validation and deployment.
Exposure to manufacturing, process development, industrialization, quality improvement or equipment-related analytics is considered an advantage.

Know-how



1. Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics



Knowledge of machine learning methods, including regression, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting and optimization.
Experience applying techniques such as feature engineering, model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning and model explainability.
Familiarity with deep learning approaches is a plus.

2. Statistics & Experimental Methods



Knowledge of statistical analysis, probability and experimental data analysis.
Experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, statistical significance and data interpretation.
Understanding of process variability, capability analysis, performance indicators and Design of Experiments (DoE).

3. Programming & Data Science Tools



Proficiency in Python and good knowledge of SQL.
Experience with data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.

4. MLOps & Industrial Deployment



Understanding of MLOps concepts, including model versioning, testing, reproducibility, CI/CD and monitoring.
Experience with cloud-based AI platforms, preferably Databricks, is an advantage.
Knowledge of APIs, containers and deployment concepts is beneficial.

5. Industrial Data & Manufacturing Systems



Experience working with structured, semi-structured and time-series data.
Familiarity with manufacturing systems and data sources such as MES, PLC, SCADA, Historian systems, test systems or production databases.
Understanding of manufacturing KPIs such as OEE, yield, scrap, downtime, cycle time, rework and process capability is an advantage.

Languages



Fluent English, written and spoken.

Working Style and Methods



Structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.
Ability to transform complex challenges into practical, scalable solutions.
Strong collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Clear communication skills and ability to present analytical insights in an actionable way.
Strong focus on quality, reusability and continuous improvement.

Personality



Curious and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies.
Proactive, collaborative and solution-oriented mindset.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Passion for data, innovation and making a tangible impact in industrial environments.


Additional Information



Work includes:



⚖️ Flexible work conditions



🔀 Hybrid work system



🌐 Exchange with colleagues around the world



🛡️ Health insurance



🧑‍⚕️ Medical office (psychology and general clinic) & Social Services Office on site



📚 Training opportunities (p.e., technical training, foreign languages training) & certifications



📈 Opportunities for career progression and continuous professional development



💲 Access to great discounts in partnerships and Bosch products



🏋️ Sports and health related activities



🚉 Great access to public transports



🚌 Free transport from Porto



💰 Flexible benefits platform



🅿️ Free parking lot



🍽️ Canteen

CAPGEMINI ENGINEERING

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

YOUR ROLE


Support the development, deployment and optimization of Data Science, Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions.
Design, build and maintain AI/ML models, ensuring performance, scalability and reliability across different business use cases.
Develop and optimize data pipelines, feature engineering processes and large-scale data processing workflows.
Implement and support MLOps practices, including model deployment, monitoring, CI/CD pipelines and lifecycle management.
Develop and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, vector databases and knowledge-driven AI applications.
Support the implementation, fine-tuning and evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs), transformer architectures and diffusion models.
Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, cloud architects and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Contribute to AI platform evolution, cloud optimization, model scaling and continuous improvement initiatives.


YOUR PROFILE


Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering or a related field.
Experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI or AI Engineering roles.
Proficiency in Python, SQL and Machine Learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
Experience with AWS AI/ML services, including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda and Comprehend.
Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, transformers and diffusion models.
Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases and knowledge graphs.
Knowledge of MLOps, containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and ECS, and CI/CD practices for ML pipelines.
Strong data engineering skills for processing large datasets using AWS Glue, Athena, Spark or similar technologies.
Understanding of cloud optimization, distributed computing and model scaling principles.
Knowledge of NLP, image generation models, multimodal AI solutions and Generative AI technologies.
Experience with fine-tuning open-source models such as LLaMA, Falcon, Mistral and Stable Diffusion.
Knowledge of ethical AI principles, bias mitigation and AI safety best practices.
AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty certification is considered a plus.
Experience with real-time AI applications, chatbot development or autonomous agent solutions is considered a plus.


What You’ll Love About Working Here


Join a multicultural and inclusive team environment.
Enjoy a supportive atmosphere promoting work life balance.
Hybrid work.
Your career growth is central to our mission. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professionals are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Access valuable training and certifications in cutting edge technologies.
Engage in exciting national and international projects.
Health and life insurance.
Referral program with bonuses for talent recommendations.
Great office locations.

We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology, and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. Title: Marketing Data Scientist
Description:
About Us 🚀

Hostelworld is the world's leading Social Travel platform - a social network-powered OTA on a mission to help travellers find their people and create unforgettable moments together. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, we're a team of around 270 people serving hostel partners across more than 180 countries.

Since launching our social network in 2022, we've welcomed over 3.4 million social members who aren't just booking trips, they're messaging, finding events, meeting up and becoming powerful brand advocates. This community generates a rich proprietary dataset of 16 million+ chat messages and 17 million bookings, powering AI-driven personalisation and network effects that no generalist OTA can replicate.

We are not just another OTA - we created an entirely new category – Social Travel. If you want to shape the future of travel by putting people and shared experiences at the heart of it, you'll fit right in here - Learn more about our Team!

Our Culture

At Hostelworld, our culture is a direct reflection of our customers: adventurous, curious, and social. We have a shared love of travel that fuels our work and connects us on a deeper level. It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

Who You'll Work With 👨🏽‍🤝‍👨🏼

You will play a key role in a diverse, highly-talented Analytics & Insights team providing insights across a number of growth units including paid marketing, customer analytics and app analytics to support decision making at C and senior management level. The Marketing Data Scientist will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed marketing strategies and decisions, with a particular emphasis on managing and optimising Google Ads bidding algorithms. As a key member of the Analytics and Insights team, this role will involve close collaboration with paid marketing, app marketing, and data teams to uncover insights, optimise campaigns, and contribute to business growth.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻

You will hone and develop a wide range of technical skills in managing our data analytics and data science products. The paid analytics team require a person who is flexible, adaptable and able to translate business needs into measurable results. It’s a rewarding experience with exciting diverse work:

Bidding & spend optimisation


Develop, manage and optimise bidding algorithms for Google Ads campaigns (Search and Hotel Price Ads) using Python, translating business objectives into bidding logic that maximises profitability (Direct Margin).
Optimise budget allocation across channels, markets and campaigns using elasticity and response-curve models to improve profitability.
Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify inefficiencies and evolve the bidding logic accordingly.


Marketing measurement & incrementality


Design, run and analyse incrementality tests (geo-lift / holdout experiments) using causal inference methods such as synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series and difference-in-differences to quantify the true incremental impact of paid channels.
Build and maintain marketing mix models (MMM) to estimate channel contribution, saturation and diminishing returns, and translate the outputs into budget recommendations.
Own and improve our attribution framework — evaluating multi-touch attribution against experimental results and platform-reported figures, and reconciling the gaps.
Design, implement and analyse A/B tests and other experiments to assess the impact of marketing initiatives, including sample-size, power and pre-registration standards.


Insight & influence


Provide data-driven recommendations on marketing spend, customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value to C-level and senior management.
Serve as a subject-matter expert on data science and measurement best practices within the Analytics & Insights team, and productionise analyses into reusable tools and recurring reports.


What We’re Looking For 👀

Experience & Qualifications:


Minimum 3 years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science role, preferably within a marketing department.
Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, or similar programming languages.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communicate clearly and with purpose, working effectively with team members and stakeholders across the organisation.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Skills


Competency in Python/R.
SQL (preferably BigQuery, Snowflake).
Strong proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modelling techniques.


Desirable Skills


Experience with marketing measurement: incrementality / geo-lift testing, holdout experiments.
Applied causal inference: synthetic control, difference-in-differences, Bayesian structural time series (e.g. CausalPy, CausalImpact, PyMC, linearmodels).
Understanding of attribution modelling (multi-touch, data-driven attribution) and its limitations relative to experimental measurement.
Understanding of digital marketing metrics, SEO, SEM and customer-journey analysis.
Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or building lightweight apps (Streamlit).
Familiarity with orchestration and ETL/ELT tools (Apache Airflow, dbt).
Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative code review.


What We Offer 💯


Competitive salary & benefits
Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
Support for your ongoing growth & development
Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days


OUR BEHAVIOURS 🏆


Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.
Collaborate - We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.
Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.


We believe in talented and diverse teams that reflect the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we operate. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences. We lay out the above requirements to guide applicants to the experiences that we believe will allow you to be successful in the role. If you don’t meet them all, please consider applying if you think you can still perform the role as described.

Hostelworld Group plc is a ground-breaking social network-powered Online Travel Agent ("OTA") with a clear mission to help travellers find people to hang out with.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Since launching its social network in 2022, the Group has welcomed over 4.0 million social members, with engagement growing faster than stays booked. Social members book approximately twice as frequently as non-members and are three times more likely to use the app, demonstrating the platform's utility and its contribution to customer lifetime value.

Our proprietary dataset, spanning over 4.0 million social members, 19.0 million chat messages and 19.0 million bookings since launch, strengthens our ability to understand traveller behaviour, personalise experiences, and build network effects that differentiate Hostelworld from generalist OTAs. This data asset, which is exclusively ours and compounds in value as our community grows, underpins our AI-powered matching and recommendation capabilities.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, Hostelworld is a recognised brand with around 275 employees, hostel and accommodation partners across more than 180 countries, and a growing suite of products including budget accommodation and Social Passes that extend the platform well beyond the traditional hostelling category.

Hostelworld has a long-standing commitment to improving the sustainability of the hostelling industry. The Group has introduced a hostel-specific Staircase to Sustainability framework, accredited by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, which helps partners adopt more sustainable practices while giving travellers clearer information for decision-making. Customers can choose to offset trip emissions, and for the fifth consecutive year the Group has retained the 'Taking Climate Action' label from South Pole.

  • Competency in Python/R.
  • SQL (preferably BigQuery, Snowflake).
  • Strong proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modelling techniques.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with marketing measurement: incrementality / geo-lift testing, holdout experiments.
  • Applied causal inference: synthetic control, difference-in-differences, Bayesian structural time series (e.g. CausalPy, CausalImpact, PyMC, linearmodels).

  • Understanding of digital marketing metrics, SEO, SEM and customer-journey analysis.
  • Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or building lightweight apps (Streamlit).
  • Familiarity with orchestration and ETL/ELT tools (Apache Airflow, dbt).
  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative code review.

What We Offer 💯

  • Competitive salary & benefits
  • Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
  • Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
  • Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
  • Support for your ongoing growth & development

  • A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days

  • Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
  • Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Title: Price Data Analyst (Paredes)
Description:
A SIXT Portugal, com sede em Paredes, Porto, é um fornecedor líder de serviços de mobilidade premium, presente em mais de 30 pontos por todo o país. Através das suas soluções SIXT rent, SIXT ride, SIXT+, bem como dos serviços direcionados para clientes Corporate e Luxury, a empresa disponibiliza uma oferta integrada, flexível e inovadora nas áreas de aluguer de veículos particulares e comerciais, transporte por aplicação e assinatura automóvel.




Com uma frota premium, uma forte cultura de inovação e uma orientação permanente para a excelência no serviço, a SIXT Portugal procura proporcionar experiências que superem as expectativas dos seus clientes, garantindo soluções de mobilidade adaptadas às suas necessidades.




As nossas Operações representam um dos principais pontos de contacto com o cliente, seja nas estações SIXT, por telefone ou por e-mail. Este departamento assume um papel essencial na qualidade da experiência do cliente, assegurando um atendimento premium, consultoria personalizada, apoio no processo de aluguer e uma gestão eficiente do dia a dia operacional.




A nível global, a SIXT é uma das principais empresas de mobilidade do mundo, contando com cerca de 7.500 colaboradores, presença em mais de 110 países e aproximadamente 2.100 estações de aluguer. Assente numa cultura de empreendedorismo, inovação, coragem para mudar e vontade de crescer, a SIXT continua a afirmar-se como uma das empresas mais dinâmicas, inovadoras e rentáveis do setor da mobilidade.




Responsabilidades:

- Analisar dados históricos de vendas, para identificar padrões e tendências.

- Monitorizar preços de mercado em diferentes canais e localizações.

- Construir, manter e atualizar modelos de pricing dinâmico que suportem decisões diárias de revenue management.

- Desenvolver e aplicar modelos preditivos com machine learning (procura, sazonalidade, impacto de promoções).

- Apoiar a equipa de gestão de frota e operações na definição de estratégias de alocação e otimização de recursos.

- Criar dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão da gestão.

- Contribuir para a definição de políticas comerciais e campanhas promocionais baseadas em análises de rentabilidade.




Perfil:

- Formação superior em Engenharia e Gestão Industrial.

- Conhecimentos de Excel avançado e SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.

- Conhecimentos em linguagens de programação (Python ou R) aplicados a análise de dados, estatística e machine learning são valorizados.

- Conhecimentos de ferramentas de visualização de dados, Power BI, Looker ou similar.

- Conhecimentos de inglês.




Oferecemos:

- Integração num Grupo sólido e credível, tendo em curso a implementação de vários projetos de crescimento.

- Formação e possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.

- Oportunidade real de progressão de carreira, de acordo com o desempenho e as competências demonstradas.

- Boas condições de trabalho e benefícios sociais (Seguro de Saúde, Seguro de Vida e possibilidade de acesso a Plano de Pensões).




Informação adicional

A SIXT Portugal pertence ao Grupo JAP, uma referência centenária no setor automóvel e da mobilidade.

O Grupo JAP representa atualmente cerca de 20 marcas automóveis, através de mais de 60 pontos de venda e reparação CARBY, detém a MATRIZAUTO, a maior megastore de viaturas seminovas e usadas do país, e é o master franchise da rent-a-car SIXT em Portugal.

Para além da sua forte presença no setor automóvel, o Grupo é também uma referência nacional no mercado das máquinas agrícolas, industriais e de movimentação de cargas, através do Entreposto Máquinas. Internacionalmente, está presente em vários mercados africanos, nomeadamente Angola, Quénia, Uganda, Tanzânia e Moçambique, onde atua nas áreas da mobilidade, veículos pesados e maquinaria agrícola e industrial.

Fazer parte do universo JAP é integrar um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução, com presença em diferentes geografias, mercados e áreas de negócio.

Se procura um desafio profissional aliciante e quer fazer parte de um projeto em crescimento, esta oportunidade é para si.

Title: SAP Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Specialist (m/f/d)
Description:
Your role in our team

As a Data Scientist (m/f/d), you will drive data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses



Your profile



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to solve complex business challenges in a structured manner
Good understanding of business contexts and the ability to identify opportunities where data analytics can improve processes and performance
Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner



Your Benefits



Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
Meaningful and challenging responsibilities that make a difference in a fast-growing industry
Diverse opportunities for further development
Competitive compensation package
Modern office, flexible working time and remote work option

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Bring your unique talents and experience to a leading company in Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions. Grow your passion into a rewarding profession by joining a dynamic and expanding organization. You’ll play a vital role that supports your success and helps drive safe, efficient, and reliable operations across industries worldwide.

Where you’ll work: This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our engineers consistently tell us they value.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

You will own machine learning solutions end to end — from framing the business problem to running models reliably in production — built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors deployed around the world.

Collaborate for success


Own machine learning projects end to end: plan the roadmap, frame the problem, build the pipelines, and take solutions through to production.
Translate business goals into ML solutions, and explain results, limitations and uncertainty to business stakeholders in terms they can act on.
Make the technical decisions, contribute significantly to the implementation, and mentor other engineers through code review and design discussion. This is a hands-on role.


Build ML-powered solutions


Deliver forecasting, classification and anomaly detection on time series from industrial IoT sensors reporting in real time from sites across the globe.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, scarce labels, and a device population that keeps evolving.
Run what you build — monitoring, drift detection and retraining — and shape the data pipelines your models depend on.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on model risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any model whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across data engineering, machine learning and MLOps, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

Minimum Requirements -


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field or equivalent combination of education and experience
5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or a closely related software engineering role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred).
Hands-on experience delivering production-level, cloud-native machine learning solutions.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong understanding of feature engineering, ML algorithms, model training and evaluation.
Solid experience across a modern ML stack: gradient boosting (LightGBM, XGBoost), scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow, and current time series tooling.
Experience operating models in production: deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining, and a feel for the MLOps practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.


Preferred Qualifications -


Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, MLflow, streaming pipelines.
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar patterns for exposing models as tools other agents can call directly.
Domain experience in industrial, energy or IoT settings.

Title: Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee (IEFP)
Description:
Join us as a Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee!

As a Business Intelligence /Data analytics Engineer Trainee you will design, build, and maintain scalable analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

You will primarily be responsible for:


Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business insights.
Develop and evaluate machine learning models for supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in data engineering, analytics, and data science.
Designing and maintaining semantic data models (star/snowflake schemas) optimized for analytics and reporting.
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Ensure data quality, consistency and performance across business intelligence solutions.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Python and R.
Translating business requirements into robust BI solutions and flexible Power BI semantic models.
Optimizing SQL queries, data models and report performance for large-scale datasets, monitoring BI workloads in cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborating with business users to understand KPIs, metrics and reporting needs, and partnering with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Product teams.
Providing guidance and best practices to analysts and report developers.
Defining and enforcing data standards, naming conventions and documentation, supporting data lineage and metadata management.
Ensuring compliance with security and privacy requirements.


Knowledge, Skills And Experience Required


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields.
Eligible for an IEFP Level VI Internship.
Good programming skills; knowledge of python, C#.
Machine learning model development and evaluation.
Data wrangling using libraries such as Pandas/Modin, Polars, NumPy.
Knowledge of multiple databases such as SQLServer, PostgreSQL, DuckDB.
API-based data ingestion.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Big Query, Redshift, SQL Server).
Hands-on with Power BI (semantic models, DAX, DirectQuery) and ETL/ELT tools (SSIS, ADF, Airflow, dbt, SSIS or similar).
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure Foundry (Nice to have).
Knowledge of data modelling techniques (Kimball, dimensional modelling).
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data models and KPIs.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organized, able to manage multiple priorities and share knowledge effectively.
Fluent in English, with good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Nice to have: experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), Python, DevOps/CI-CD for BI, data governance frameworks.


Apply by submitting your CV in English.

Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €1B. We believe in transforming technology to create value for our clients, partners and employees in a world where technology is developed for people. We are proud of the culture we have built together. We are proud of our people at the service of technology. We are proud of our diverse environment. Because we are #TechforPeople. Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries. Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description

We are seeking a versatile and passionate AI / Machine Learning Engineer to join our data science and engineering team. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between data science research and production-ready applications, building scalable machine learning systems that drive business value. This role requires a strong balance of software engineering principles and ML expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines for training, testing, and deployment of predictive models.
  • Work closely with Data Scientists to translate prototypes and models into scalable, production-grade code (MLOps).
  • Develop robust, efficient, and well-documented code primarily using Python and relevant ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Implement monitoring and alerting solutions for models in production to track performance, detect drift, and ensure reliability.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure efficient data preparation, feature engineering, and access to necessary data infrastructure.
  • Stay current with the latest advancements in AI, ML techniques, and scalable infrastructure.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a Machine Learning Engineer, AI Developer, or similar role.
  • Strong expertise in Python and object-oriented programming, with a focus on code quality and best practices.
  • Mandatory practical experience with major Machine Learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn).
  • Solid understanding of MLOps principles and the tools required for model deployment, versioning, and lifecycle management (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar).
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets and data warehousing concepts.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively.
  • Experience working with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for model deployment, compute, and storage (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML Services).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) for building reproducible and scalable ML environments.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark).
  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Very good level of English, both spoken and written, for effective communication with international teams;


Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AI Engineer to join our team in Porto and help build the next generation of AI-native productivity inside Superhuman, specifically the agent platform where multiple AI agents collaborate to solve complex user problems. The ideal candidate is deeply excited about what's possible with LLMs today, has experience building with agents and AI workflows, and brings strong product sense alongside their engineering skills. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role on a foundational team that moves fast from idea to production.

We are evolving Superhuman Docs' collaborative workspaces so that users can solve arbitrarily complex tasks with agents, leveraging Superhuman’s ubiquitous UI.

As an AI Engineer on this team, you will be at the heart of our company's transformation.

In This Role, You Will


Shape the Future of Productivity: Play a pivotal role in evolving Grammarly from a beloved writing assistant into an indispensable, AI-native productivity suite for enterprises.
Build a Groundbreaking AI Agent Platform: Spearhead the development of a new platform where multiple AI agents collaborate to solve complex user problems. You will be responsible for the core orchestration, routing, and planning systems.
Own Critical ML Systems: Develop and deploy sophisticated ML models for core product experiences, including search ranking and proactive suggestions that anticipate user needs.
Integrate Cutting-Edge AI: Work at the forefront of the AI landscape, building ML components that integrate with the latest and most powerful models to create magical user experiences.
Thrive in a High-Impact Environment: Join a foundational team where you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and product sense in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Ship Your Work Fast: Move quickly from idea to impact. We have no red tape or endless approvals—just a focus on making meaningful contributions to a platform used by millions.


Qualifications


5+ years of industry experience as a machine learning engineer or applied research scientist.
A deep understanding of modern algorithms and approaches to ML, NLP, and LLMs.
Experience building LLM-based products.
A deep care about the end-user experience and strives to ensure high quality.
Ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manage tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyze and execute work efficiently, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrive in fast-paced, results-driven environments.
MS/PhD in Computer Science is a nice-to-have.


We invite you to share your knowledge, experience, and goals with us to help us find the best team match for you. Tell us your superpower!

Support for you, professionally and personally


Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being
A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.
Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Portugal: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.
Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.


We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

Compensation Range: €75K - €105K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst will build and maintain a comprehensive workforce visibility platform for Global Platforms, tracking headcount, allocation, costs, and capabilities to enable strategic decision-making. Working at the intersection of Technology, Finance, and HR, they will own the people data ecosystem—from pipelines and dashboards to AI-enabled insights—while acting as a trusted partner to leadership in workforce planning, capacity tracking, and operating model efficiency.

Blip is a leading tech company focused on software engineering solutions for sports entertainment.

We operate at scale. As part of Flutter Entertainment, we play an essential role in the Group's goal of becoming the global leader in online sports betting and iGaming, developing innovative products and platforms for over 14 million monthly customers worldwide.

We are serious about Tech. We are problem-solvers with big ambitions, keeping a people-first mindset at the core of our work. We prioritize flexibility as we strive to deliver the best technological products and tackle the greatest industry challenges.

Recognizing that everyone brings their own strengths, backgrounds and new perspectives, we empower you to be yourself. That uniqueness shapes the culture of belonging we are so proud of.

The role


Global Platforms operates at significant scale (~600 people), requiring a live, accurate, view of workforce composition, allocation, cost, and capability.
This role is responsible for building and maintaining that view — enabling leadership to understand who we have, where they are deployed, how their time is spent, and how this aligns to investment, delivery and efficiency outcomes.
The role sits at the intersection of Technology, Finance, and HR, combining data engineering, analytics, and business insight.
It will also be central to the evolution of AI-enabled tooling, dashboards, and processes to continuously improve visibility, forecasting and decision-making.


What You'll Be Doing

Workforce Visibility & allocation:


Maintain a single, accurate view of all people (~600) across Global Platforms, tracking organisational structure and role types, squad/platform allocation, location and cost centre, skills and capability profiles
Provide clear insight into how resources are distributed vs strategic priorities


Capacity & Investment Tracking


Track how time is spent across capitalised delivery, operational activity, and training/development
Ensure alignment between reported effort, financial capitalisation, and delivery plans
Identify and resolve inconsistencies between engineering, finance, and planning views


Workforce Planning & Change Management


Track and govern vacancy creation and conversion (role-type changes), and new headcount approvals vs actual recruitment
Maintain an auditable view of workforce evolution over time
Support scenario modelling for workforce planning decisions


Financial Alignment & Budget Governance


Partner closely with Finance to track workforce costs vs budget, and ensure alignment between headcount, allocation, and financial forecasts
Provide leadership with clear, reconciled views of spend vs plan


Workforce Efficiency & Ratio Analysis


Define and track key operational ratios, e.g., engineering vs product vs support; build vs run; seniority mix
Identify opportunities to improve operating model efficiency and effectiveness


Data Platform, Tooling & AI Enablement


Own and evolve the People Data ecosystem, including data pipelines across HR, Finance, and Engineering systems; dashboards and reporting layers
Design scalable, AI-enabled approaches to automate insights generation, improve data quality management, and enable self-service access for leadership
Reduce manual reporting overhead and dependency risks.


Leadership Support & Insight Generation


Act as a trusted partner to Global Platforms leadership
Translate complex data into clear narratives, actionable insights and decision-ready outputs
Support strategic initiatives with robust workforce data and modelling


What You'll Bring


Deep experience in workforce analytics, financial analysis, or operational planning, going beyond pure data reporting, with a track record of delivering complex analytical projects that shape business direction.
Strong commercial and business knowledge, ideally within sports betting, gaming, or a related sector.
Proven ability to work across Tech, Finance, and HR domains
Experience managing large-scale, multi-source, sometimes incomplete or ambiguous datasets
Degree (or equivalent) in a relevant technical field such as Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or Engineering/ a track record of excellence in subjects with a mathematical or statistical focus.
Strong understanding of workforce planning concepts; financial/capex tracking; engineering or delivery structures
Ability to connect data to commercial and operational outcomes
Strong stakeholder management (Tech + Finance + HR)
Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences including senior stakeholders, delivering output that is clear and succinct despite the subject being complex.
Proven ability to work independently and provide a personal resolution to projects, while also supporting the Delivery & Continuous Improvement and wider Global Platforms team.
Proactive and collaborative, with strong cross-functional relationship-building skills and the ability to drive alignment on priorities.
Curious and questioning approach with a high level of attention to detail
Willingness to learn and continuously improve.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Experience using SQL to query large relational databases.
Knowledge of statistical programming software and techniques (e.g., Python, R).
Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or EazyBI — including building scalable, well-governed dashboards.
Experience with ETL data pipelines and statistical/data modelling techniques.
Understanding of Jira / GitHub data ecosystems
Working knowledge of cloud computing (e.g., AWS), machine learning concepts, and distributed database architecture is desirable.
Advanced use of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.


This is what you should have. What do we have, you ask? Well...you can check our amazing perks @ benefits right here !

So ... Are you in?

Equal opportunities

At Blip, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strongly encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking, and working to apply.

We are committed to including everyone regardless of their race, disability, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, and religion.

Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don’t have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role.

If you need any adjustments to apply for the position and to ensure this role aligns with your needs, please send an email to accommodations@blip.pt .

We will only respond to inquiries related to disabilities.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
Description:
About azakaw

azakaw is a purpose-built RegTech compliance platform backed by the regulatory expertise of j. awan & partners, a leading international GRC consultancy headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The platform automates KYC, KYB, AML and ongoing monitoring for regulated institutions across the GCC, Africa, and emerging markets, covering over 1,700 screening lists, more than 24,000 identity document types, liveness and deepfake detection, and national integrations such as Nafath and Yakeen in Saudi Arabia. The engineering function is based in Porto, Portugal.




Culture and Values

Growth mindset, resilience, accountability, and adaptability in a fast-paced scaling environment.
Ownership from problem to production. Engineers here decide how the product is built, and carry the consequences of those decisions.
Professional maturity and integrity in handling sensitive client and regulatory data.
Pragmatism over novelty. We use AI where it creates real value and conventional engineering where it does not.
Trust and credibility built through consistent follow-through, transparency, and candid communication.




Mission

A hands-on engineering role responsible for the development, integration and optimisation of Artificial Intelligence solutions applied to azakaw’s client onboarding and client management processes, within the project "AI RegTech and Intelligent CRM for Compliance and Customer Experience".
You build and ship AI-based capabilities into the azakaw platform. This is a delivery role, not a research role. We are looking for someone who works fluently with AI-assisted development and can turn a business problem into working software in days rather than months, while holding the quality bar expected of a product used by regulated financial institutions.
The scope of the role follows the product roadmap and the priorities of the project. It is not limited to a fixed list of components, and you will be expected to work across the stack and across product areas. Title: Analista de Dados (m/f) - SHEQ
Description:
Descrição da Oportunidade

Estamos a reforçar a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, responsável por apoiar a definição de diretrizes, standards, indicadores e práticas de gestão em Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade em todo o Grupo. Uma das nossas prioridades é evoluir para uma gestão SHEQ cada vez mais orientada por dados, capaz de antecipar riscos, identificar tendências e apoiar decisões mais informadas.

Procuramos um/a Analista de Dados para apoiar a definição, recolha, tratamento, automatização e análise de dados SHEQ, transformando informação operacional proveniente de diferentes fontes em dashboards, indicadores e insights acionáveis para diferentes níveis da organização.

Em articulação com a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, IT e equipas SHEQ e operacionais das várias unidades de negócio, contribuirá para transformar dados e tendências em informação útil para antecipar riscos, melhorar decisões e reforçar o desempenho SHEQ do Grupo

Requisitos da Função


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou área equivalente.
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em análise de dados, Business Intelligence, reporting corporativo, gestão e consolidação de informação ou funções similares.
Domínio de Power BI, DAX e Power Query, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios corporativos.
Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e bases de dados relacionais. Conhecimentos de Python ou de outras linguagens de análise e tratamento de dados serão valorizados.
Experiência na recolha, tratamento, validação, harmonização e consolidação de dados provenientes de múltiplos projetos, empresas ou unidades de negócio.
Conhecimentos de modelação de dados, definição de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e estruturação de modelos de informação para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Experiência na integração e automatização de fluxos de dados, incluindo processos ETL, APIs, Power Platform ou ferramentas equivalentes.
Conhecimentos de estatística aplicada e análise exploratória de dados, incluindo a identificação de tendências, correlações, desvios e fatores de risco. Experiência em analítica avançada ou modelos preditivos será valorizada.
Conhecimentos de governação, qualidade e gestão de dados, assegurando a sua integridade, consistência, rastreabilidade e comparabilidade entre diferentes fontes de informação.
Fluência em português (obrigatório) e inglês (mínimo B2). Conhecimentos de espanhol ou francês serão valorizados.
Conhecimento dos processos e indicadores de Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade (SHEQ), incluindo gestão de incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, observações, riscos, não conformidades e desempenho ambiental, será valorizado.
Conhecimento dos referenciais ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 será valorizado.
Disponibilidade para deslocações pontuais a projetos e mercados internacionais.


Principais tarefas


Definição, em articulação com as áreas SHEQ e operacionais, dos indicadores, dados e critérios de reporte necessários à monitorização do desempenho SHEQ.
Estruturação, harmonização e validação de dados provenientes de diferentes empresas, geografias e sistemas, assegurando a sua qualidade, consistência e comparabilidade.
Automatização dos processos de recolha, consolidação e tratamento de dados, promovendo a fiabilidade da informação.
Colaboração no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de plataformas, ferramentas de reporte e soluções digitais de suporte aos processos SHEQ.
Integração e análise de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, identificando tendências, desvios, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos corporativos, assegurando a qualidade e atualização da informação.
Produção de análises e insights sobre indicadores SHEQ, incluindo incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, não conformidades, ações corretivas e desempenho ambiental.
Implementação de mecanismos de monitorização da qualidade dos dados e promoção de boas práticas de governação da informação.
Apoio à identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria através da análise de tendências e do cruzamento de dados entre processos e unidades de negócio.
Exploração de soluções de análise avançada, inteligência artificial e modelos preditivos aplicados à melhoria do desempenho SHEQ.
Apoio à realização de auditorias internas e externas.


Perfil de competências


Pensamento analítico e rigor, com preocupação pela qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados.
Capacidade de comunicar através dos dados, traduzindo análises complexas em informação clara, útil e orientada à decisão.
Visão de negócio e sensibilidade SHEQ, compreendendo os processos operacionais e as necessidades de informação que suportam a tomada de decisão.
Autonomia e proatividade, com capacidade para propor soluções e promover a melhoria contínua.
Colaboração e relacionamento interpessoal, trabalhando em articulação com equipas SHEQ, IT, outras áreas corporativas e operacionais das diferentes unidades de negócio.
Curiosidade técnica e aprendizagem contínua, acompanhando a evolução das ferramentas de dados, automação e análise avançada.
Adaptabilidade e sensibilidade intercultural, essenciais num contexto internacional e multissetorial.
Orientação para o impacto, contribuindo para a melhoria do desempenho SHEQ e para a criação de valor para o Grupo.


O que oferecemos


Integração num Grupo multinacional de referência, com presença internacional e projetos em diferentes setores e geografias.
Oportunidade de desempenhar uma função com impacto direto na forma como a informação SHEQ é recolhida, analisada e utilizada para suportar a tomada de decisão.
Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital, contribuindo para a evolução dos sistemas de informação, indicadores e ferramentas de gestão SHEQ.
Trabalho com dados provenientes de diferentes projetos, empresas e geografias, proporcionando uma visão abrangente do negócio e dos seus desafios operacionais.
Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares das áreas SHEQ, Operações, Tecnologia e Gestão.
Possibilidade de aplicar e desenvolver competências em análise de dados, automação, Business Intelligence e análise avançada.
Ambiente de aprendizagem contínua, com contacto com diferentes realidades operacionais, culturas e práticas de gestão.
