Title: (Senior) Analytics Solutions Engineer
HTML:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist that develops and produces sustainable, safe and convenient solutions for automotive manufacturers as well as industrial and end customers worldwide.

Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Job Description

As a (Senior) Analytics Solutions Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of business-critical analytics solutions that support decision-making across Product Management, Sales, and Strategy in EMEA (Strategy, Analytics and Marketing).

This role focuses on the design, development, and continuous enhancement of Power BI applications that translate complex data into actionable insights with measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand key challenges and ensure that analytical solutions address real decision-making needs. In parallel, you will act as a central interface to Data Engineering and IT, ensuring that requirements are translated into scalable and sustainable data solutions.

You will own and further develop already existing tools as technical key user with a strong focus on performance, usability, quality and active user management.

Your work will directly influence strategic decisions, uncover growth opportunities, and contribute to tangible business value across the organization.

Your main responsibilities:

  • Own and further develop Power BI applications and dashboard ecosystems;
  • Design analytics solutions that enable business decision-making beyond standard reporting;
  • Gather, translate and formalize business requirements into scalable technical solutions and user stories;
  • Independently acquire, integrate, transform and model data for Power BI solutions from multiple enterprise sources;
  • Build and maintain a consistent single source of truth across business-critical datasets;
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to identify data gaps and enable integration of additional data sources;
  • Work closely with stakeholders across Business, Product, Data Engineering and IT to ensure alignment and adoption;
  • Ensure analytics solutions deliver measurable business value and continuously improve performance, usability and relevance;
  • Support rollout and continuous improvement of analytics products in collaboration with the Product Owner.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a comparable field;
  • Multiple years of experience in Power BI development, BI (data modeling, DAX, data integration, performance optimization);
  • Proven track record of delivering analytics solutions with measurable business impact;
  • Experience designing intuitive, user-centric BI applications with a strong focus on UX/UI;
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases;
  • Experience integrating and modeling data from enterprise sources (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Hive, Azure-based platforms; experience with Microsoft Fabric is a plus);
  • Experience collaborating with Data Engineering teams and translating business requirements into technical solutions;
  • Experience working in Agile teams using Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with both business and technical stakeholders;
  • Structured, solution-oriented mindset with strong ownership;
  • Knowledge of automotive, vehicle, tire, or fitment data (is a plus);
  • Proficient English language skills (written and verbal);
  • Willingness to travel occasionally within EMEA.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a builder mindset - someone who does not just analyze data, but actively designs and delivers solutions that create real business impact. Strong business affinity and understanding how decisions are made in real-world, complex environments, translating that understanding into effective analytics products and BI applications.

This role requires a hands-on professional who thrives in the bridge between business and technology, takes full ownership of their work, and continuously improves the solutions they build.

You should be proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working in an Agile environment with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful, data-driven outcomes.

Additional Information

Our offer:

  • Integration in a challenging and international work environment;
  • Flexible working model;
  • Collaborative working style;
  • Continuous opportunities for personal development and learning.

We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and valued. All kind of applications are welcome.

Title: Product Analytics Team Lead
Description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:


Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up
Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions


YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:


You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it


Bonus points for:


Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
A strong statistics background
Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
Data catalogues like DataHub


OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:


Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
Experimentation: GrowthBook
Self-service analytics: Omni
ML workflows: Prefect
GenAI: Claude


If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?


An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:


Your CV in English
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

  • Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
  • Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

  • You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
  • You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
  • Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
  • You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
  • You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
  • When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
  • A strong statistics background
  • Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
  • Data catalogues like DataHub

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

  • Warehouse: Snowflake
  • Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
  • Experimentation: GrowthBook
  • Self-service analytics: Omni
  • ML workflows: Prefect
  • GenAI: Claude

If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English
  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role Overview

This is a long-term fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.

What You Will Do


Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.


Who You Are


5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.


Nice-to-have


Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
DBT experience for analytics engineering.
Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.


Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

Title: Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee (IEFP)
Description:
Join us as a Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee!

As a Business Intelligence /Data analytics Engineer Trainee you will design, build, and maintain scalable analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

You will primarily be responsible for:


Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business insights.
Develop and evaluate machine learning models for supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in data engineering, analytics, and data science.
Designing and maintaining semantic data models (star/snowflake schemas) optimized for analytics and reporting.
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Ensure data quality, consistency and performance across business intelligence solutions.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Python and R.
Translating business requirements into robust BI solutions and flexible Power BI semantic models.
Optimizing SQL queries, data models and report performance for large-scale datasets, monitoring BI workloads in cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborating with business users to understand KPIs, metrics and reporting needs, and partnering with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Product teams.
Providing guidance and best practices to analysts and report developers.
Defining and enforcing data standards, naming conventions and documentation, supporting data lineage and metadata management.
Ensuring compliance with security and privacy requirements.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields.
Eligible for an IEFP Level VI Internship.
Good programming skills; knowledge of python, C#.
Machine learning model development and evaluation.
Data wrangling using libraries such as Pandas/Modin, Polars, NumPy.
Knowledge of multiple databases such as SQLServer, PostgreSQL, DuckDB.
API-based data ingestion.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Big Query, Redshift, SQL Server).
Hands-on with Power BI (semantic models, DAX, DirectQuery) and ETL/ELT tools (SSIS, ADF, Airflow, dbt, SSIS or similar).
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure Foundry (Nice to have).
Knowledge of data modelling techniques (Kimball, dimensional modelling).
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data models and KPIs.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organized, able to manage multiple priorities and share knowledge effectively.
Fluent in English, with good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Nice to have: experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), Python, DevOps/CI-CD for BI, data governance frameworks.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Bring your unique talents and experience to a leading company in Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions. Grow your passion into a rewarding profession by joining a dynamic and expanding organization. You’ll play a vital role that supports your success and helps drive safe, efficient, and reliable operations across industries worldwide.

Where you’ll work: This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our engineers consistently tell us they value.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

You will own machine learning solutions end to end — from framing the business problem to running models reliably in production — built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors deployed around the world.

Collaborate for success


Own machine learning projects end to end: plan the roadmap, frame the problem, build the pipelines, and take solutions through to production.
Translate business goals into ML solutions, and explain results, limitations and uncertainty to business stakeholders in terms they can act on.
Make the technical decisions, contribute significantly to the implementation, and mentor other engineers through code review and design discussion. This is a hands-on role.


Build ML-powered solutions


Deliver forecasting, classification and anomaly detection on time series from industrial IoT sensors reporting in real time from sites across the globe.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, scarce labels, and a device population that keeps evolving.
Run what you build — monitoring, drift detection and retraining — and shape the data pipelines your models depend on.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on model risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any model whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across data engineering, machine learning and MLOps, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

Minimum Requirements -

Title: Business Analyst
HTML:
Agradecemos o teu interesse nesta oportunidade! A tua candidatura só será considerada completa após a realização de um assessment digital. No final da candidatura, e caso cumpras os critérios necessários para a função, receberás no email de registo um link para aceder ao mesmo. Esta etapa é obrigatória, já que o nosso processo de recrutamento se baseia na avaliação de competências.


Somos uma empresa de todos e para todos. Na MC, colocamos as pessoas no centro: clientes, colaboradores e comunidade. Criamos valor juntos, inovamos a cada passo e lideramos de forma próxima, reconhecendo as qualidades de cada um. Diferentes histórias e ideias unem-nos no mesmo propósito: crescer e chegar à melhor versão de nós próprios. Porque tudo o que somos, conseguimos juntos.

Por isso, junta-te a nós!


Estamos à procura de Business Analyst para integrar a nossa equipa de CoE Value, em Matosinhos e acreditamos que seremos #betterwithyou!


No âmbito do nosso Center of Excellence in Value, a nossa missão é apoiar e desafiar o negócio no reforço da nossa proposta de valor e influenciar positivamente a forma como os clientes percecionam o valor. Combinamos dados, insights de mercado e de negócio para identificar oportunidades e apoiar uma melhor tomada de decisão, particularmente em torno de pricing, promoções e outros elementos-chave da nossa proposta de valor.


Procuramos um Business Analyst com uma forte capacidade analítica para integrar a nossa equipa. Esta função encontra-se na interseção entre análise de dados, estratégia de negócio e consultoria interna, transformando questões de negócio complexas em insights claros e recomendações acionáveis.


Terás a oportunidade de trabalhar com diferentes áreas da organização, estando exposto(a) a uma ampla variedade de temas de negócio e a diferentes stakeholders séniores. Esta experiência permitirá desenvolver uma visão abrangente do negócio e contribuir para discussões estratégicas relevantes.


Contamos contigo para…

  • Utilizar ferramentas analíticas como SQL e Python para explorar, manipular e analisar dados;
  • Analisar conjuntos de dados grandes e diversificados para responder a questões de negócio relevantes e gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Estruturar problemas de negócio ambíguos, definir hipóteses e determinar as análises necessárias para chegar a conclusões robustas;
  • Combinar diferentes fontes de informação para identificar padrões, tendências, riscos e oportunidades;
  • Transformar resultados analíticos complexos em conclusões e recomendações de negócio claras;
  • Questionar pressupostos e formas de pensar existentes através de análises baseadas em factos;
  • Colaborar com diferentes equipas em toda a organização em temas de negócio e estratégicos relevantes.


Por isso, traz contigo…

  • 1–4 anos de experiência profissional, idealmente em análise de dados, consultoria ou outro contexto orientado por dados;
  • Formação académica numa área quantitativa ou analítica, como Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Data Analytics, Gestão ou similar;
  • Fortes competências analíticas e experiência em análise prática de dados;
  • À-vontade na utilização de SQL e/ou Python para explorar, manipular e analisar dados;
  • Forte pensamento crítico e curiosidade, com capacidade para estruturar problemas complexos, questionar pressupostos e identificar insights relevantes;
  • Uma mentalidade orientada para o negócio, com capacidade para transformar resultados analíticos em conclusões e recomendações claras;
  • Boas competências de comunicação e capacidade para trabalhar eficazmente com diferentes stakeholders em toda a organização;
  • Experiência em retalho, pricing, promoções ou análise comercial será valorizada, mas não é obrigatória;
  • Experiência com PowerPoint e ferramentas de visualização de dados também não é obrigatória, mas será considerada uma mais-valia.


O que temos para ti…

  • Descobre aqui todos os nossos benefícios nas áreas de Saúde e Bem-Estar, Compensação e Benefícios, Família e Parentalidade, Desenvolvimento de Carreira e Flexibilidade.


#BETTERTOGETHER #BETTERWITHYOU


Compromisso de D&I MC Sonae:

Trabalhamos para criar um ambiente de trabalho assente na riqueza de perfis e com foco na singularidade, garantindo que todos se sentem respeitados, valorizados pelas suas competências e têm confiança na organização.

Sobre a Empresa




A Solverde.pt é uma marca portuguesa de jogo online. Desde o seu lançamento em Setembro de 2017, temos vindo a trabalhar todos os dias para oferecer o melhor produto de jogo online do país.




Sobre a Função




Procuramos um(a) Data & Business Analyst altamente qualificado(a) para integrar a nossa equipa.

A função irá apoiar a performance, reporting e otimização dos nossos produtos, com especial foco em apostas desportivas. Irá trabalhar de perto com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades, analisar resultados e apoiar iniciativas que melhorem a experiência do utilizador e os resultados do negócio.




Responsabilidades




Recolher, analisar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados para identificar tendências, riscos e insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão.
Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios para acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas de negócio.
Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar e definir necessidades de negócio e necessidades de dados.
Elaborar e implementar ferramentas e metodologias de análise de dados para melhorar a qualidade e a precisão da informação.
Comunicar conclusões e insights resultantes da análise de dados a stakeholders relevantes.
Monitorizar e avaliar continuamente a exatidão, integralidade e consistência dos dados.







Qualificações




Experiência prévia numa função analítica (experiência comprovada em análise de dados, análise de negócio ou área relacionada).
Forte formação académica e/ou experiência numa área quantitativa.
Fluência em inglês (oral e escrito).







Competências Requeridas







Forte capacidade analítica e de pensamento crítico, com capacidade para recolher, organizar, analisar e disseminar grandes volumes de informação.
Excelentes competências de resolução de problemas, com foco na tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI).
Experiência com SQL e Python.
Excelentes competências de comunicação, tanto oral como escrita, com capacidade para apresentar informação complexa de forma clara e acessível.
Forte atenção ao detalhe, com foco na exatidão e integralidade dos dados.
Conhecimento de produtos de sportsbook, comportamento dos jogadores e mecânicas de apostas desportivas é uma mais-valia.







Se é um(a) profissional orientado(a) por dados, com paixão por apostas desportivas e otimização de produto, esta poderá ser a oportunidade certa para ti.




Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.



Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Title: GCP Data Analyst -French Speaker (Porto,Hibrido)
Description:
Principais Responsabilidades


Gerir incidentes de forma eficaz, minimizando o impacto nas operações e implementando as evoluções necessárias nos sistemas.
Desenvolver componentes específicos no âmbito de projetos de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para a melhoria global das capacidades de dados.
Utilizar o Google Cloud Platform (GCP), nomeadamente o BigQuery e o Composer, para otimizar a gestão e a análise de dados.
Utilizar o Power BI para a elaboração de relatórios e visualização de dados, bem como ferramentas de integração, como o SSIS, para garantir um fluxo de dados contínuo e eficiente.
Trabalhar sob a supervisão de um Squad Lead, de forma a assegurar uma coordenação eficaz e a execução bem-sucedida dos projetos.
Manter uma comunicação proativa com os intervenientes das áreas de negócio, com o objetivo de compreender as suas necessidades e traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos.


Requisitos mínimos


4+ anos de experiência com GCP, com sólidos conhecimentos de práticas de gestão e integração de dados.
Experiência sólida com Power BI e ferramentas de integração de dados, como SSIS.
Conhecimentos de linguagens de programação, nomeadamente Python e SQL, para análise e tratamento de dados.
Experiência em ambientes Agile, incluindo a participação em reuniões diárias e processos de desenvolvimento iterativo.
Domínio de inglês e francês obrigatório, com nível mínimo B2.
